entities.summary: Ryuji Sasai  is a Japanese video game composer and bass guitarist. He is best known for his work on Xak, Final Fantasy Legend III and Final Fantasy Mystic Quest. His musical career came about when he was 15 years old, and he formed a band. Before entering the gaming industry, Sasai was involved in the anime department, scoring two television series and a film. After creating music for four games as a freelancer, he was employed at Square from 1991 to 1998, where he worked on five games in total. Sasai often collaborated with fellow composers Tadahiro Nitta and Chihiro Fujioka during his career.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Ryuji Sasai's work on Final Fantasy Mystic Quest and other games contributed to the development of the RPG genre in Japan, influencing a generation of game composers. His collaboration with Tadahiro Nitta and Chihiro Fujioka helped shape the soundtracks of several notable games.
